Element.Name: plan
Element.attribute: Kick off the project and define the project management plan (PMP). Review in-scope business capabilities with key client stakeholders. Facilitate security and controls workshops, develop the change management strategy and prepare for the upcoming fit-gap and technical workshops.

Element.Name: initiate_project
Element.attribute: Identify key client stakeholders and establish the core project team with representation from the client and EY. Additionally, develop the project charter and schedule and formally launch the project with the core team.

Element.Name: define_project_manage_plan
Element.attribute: Define the project governance structure, design authority and document the project management plan (PMP).

Element.Name: gather_information
Element.attribute: Review the request for proposal (RFP) and begin populating the requirements traceability matrix (RTM). Gather any additional information needed to better understand the client's current and desired business capabilities and supporting processes.

Element.Name: confirm_target_bus_capab
Element.attribute: Meet with key client stakeholders to confirm the business capabilities that will be part of the future state. Begin identifying the out-of-the-box Oracle process flows and EY pre-solutioned assets needed to enable the in-scope capabilities.

Element.Name: prepare_fit_gap_workshops
Element.attribute: Based on the in-scope business capabilities, schedule workshops with key client stakeholders to analyze whether the associated out-of-the-box Oracle business process flows meet the requirements of the business.

Element.Name: conduct_oracle_trusted_workshops
Element.attribute: Prepare for and conduct Oracle Trusted workshops with key client stakeholders to highlight any risks that could arise from failures around security and controls.

Element.DisplayName: Define Vision and Case for Change
